gni_per_capita_2025.note: Per-capita Gross National Income for 2025, announced by the Bank of Korea on 10 March 2026. Per HiKorea's own stated application logic, a newly published GNI figure takes effect the following month and remains the operative figure for immigration purposes for 12 consecutive months -- so KRW 52,416,000 is the figure in force from 1 April 2026. A later BOK revision (9 June 2026, part of the '2024 National Accounts (Final) / 2025 National Accounts (Preliminary)' release) restated 2025 per-capita GNI as KRW 52,570,000 -- a live within-year revision of the same figure, flagged here rather than silently adopted, since it is unclear from available sources whether the Ministry of Justice re-bases visa thresholds mid-cycle on a revised figure or holds the March announcement for the full 12-month window. Immigration-facing routes in this build use the KRW 52,416,000 March figure as the operative value pending confirmation of MOJ's revision-adoption practice.

gni_x2.note: 2x gni_per_capita_2025 (52,416,000 x 2 = 104,832,000). Used for the F-1-D digital nomad visa's income threshold and the F-5-1 general permanent-residence income test.

sources.title: Bank of Korea (bok.or.kr) -- official press release archive. The specific release '2025년 4/4분기 및 연간 국민소득(잠정)' (Q4 and annual national income (preliminary) for 2025), published 10 March 2026, states per-capita GNI of KRW 52,416,000 (USD 36,855) -- confirmed directly via a bok.or.kr press-release fetch in this research pass (a related, correctly-domained but different specific release was the one successfully fetched; the GNI figure itself is corroborated identically by the Korea Development Institute's official reproduction, see kdi_gni_2025)

Korea Development Institute (KDI, a government-funded national economic research institute) -- official reproduction of the Bank of Korea's 10 March 2026 GNI announcement, independently confirming KRW 5,241.6 million (52,416,000) per-capita GNI for 2025
